I had a very positive experience at Rumpaporn Chinese Clinic in Chiang Mai.
I came with severe sciatica caused by four herniated discs in my lumbar spine, and after four sessions of acupuncture, electrical stimulation, and cupping, my pain diminished enormously.

The doctor is extremely professional, serious, and thorough. Every session was conducted with great care, and I didn’t feel any pain when the needles were inserted or removed.

The clinic is run by three sisters, who are all very kind, attentive, and always available to answer questions. The level of English of the interpreter is excellent, which made communication very easy and reassuring.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone dealing with chronic pain or spinal issues. I will definitely return every time I come to Chiang Mai.
